1. `testing/fake-share-api.ts`: `installFakeShareApi(baseUrl = 'http://api.test/v1', appOrigin = 'http://app.test')` stubs global `fetch` with `vi.stubGlobal` and returns `{ requests: Array<{ method, url, body }>, restore }`.
   - `POST {baseUrl}/shares`:
     - `validateSharePayload(body.payload)` and `computeAdult(pages)`.
     - Id `'s'` + a counter left-padded with '0' to 25 digits; owner token 43 characters from `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`.
     - 201 JSON per `shareCreateResponseSchema`, url `appOrigin + '/s/' + id`.
   - `GET {baseUrl}/shares/:id`: 200 per `shareGetResponseSchema` with the computed adult, or a 404 envelope.
   - Content-Type application/json. This mirrors the server's authority; it never trusts the posted adult flag. It lives under `testing/`, which the app bundle never includes.
2. `integration/publish-snapshot-share.integration.spec.ts` (real fake-indexeddb; stub only `fetch` and `navigator.clipboard`; clear localStorage in `beforeEach`; provide `API_BASE_URL` and `APP_ORIGIN` as above):
   - **Adult publish, identical view.**
     - `LibraryStore.create()`, then load in `CharacterStore`. `updateCore({ name: 'Vesper Hale', species: 'fox-morph' })`, `addPage('intimacy')`, `updatePage('intimacy', { ...createIntimacyDefault(), relationshipContext: 'open, married' })`.
     - `ShareStore.publishSnapshot(id, ['intimacy'])`. Assert `ShareRepo.get` returns the row with ownerToken and includedTypes ['intimacy'].
     - Mount CharacterPage with `VIEW_MODE_PREVIEW` true and mode 'view', render the defer block, then capture `.title-text` text, `.subdoc-title` texts, section nav link labels, and the `cd-plugin-outlet` text content.
     - Reset TestBed and mount SharePage with the share id. Assert `cd-adult-interstitial` is present and `cd-character-header` absent.
     - Click 'I am 18 or older', render the defer block, and assert all captured values are equal and `input, textarea, select` count is 0.
   - **Header-only publish.** `includedTypes []`: SharePage shows `.title-text` immediately, no interstitial, zero `cd-subdoc-host`.
   - **Save to my library.** From the adult share's ready state, click 'Save to my library'. `CharacterRepo.list()` has 2 characters; the new one has a different id and name 'Vesper Hale'. The shares store `getAll` still has exactly 1 row.
  </action>

## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| SPA to API origin | browser connections allowed by CSP |
| www host to apex | canonical origin for share URLs |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Severity | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|-----------|----------|-----------|----------|-------------|-----------------|
| T-03-06-01 | Elevation of Privilege | CSP connect-src | medium | mitigate | Adds exactly one https origin; smoke and node checks assert the exact directive; script-src and frame-ancestors unchanged. |
| T-03-06-02 | Spoofing | www host serving a second origin | low | mitigate | 301 to the apex before assets are served, so share URLs exist under one origin. |
| T-03-06-03 | Tampering | fake API diverging from the server | low | mitigate | Fake recomputes adult with the shared `computeAdult` and validates with `validateSharePayload`; server behavior is proven separately in 03-02/03-03. |
</threat_model>
